_doc: Curated recurring songs 李豆沙 performs, so song-lane identification is DETERMINISTIC instead of depending on the flaky LLM song-hint + text search (which mis-guessed 《屑屑》 as 快乐崇拜/穷开心 and lost it entirely, 2026-07-07).
